skill.name: agent-tools
skill.description: Guide agents to use the inference.sh CLI for hosted AI apps, including app discovery, media generation, LLM calls, search, task tracking, and Twitter/X automation.
skill.summary: Use inference.sh CLI commands to discover and run hosted AI apps.
skill.author: inference-sh-6

security_audit.summary: The skill is transparent about using the inference.sh CLI, but several install instructions use curl-to-shell and remote binary installation patterns. Most API-key and documentation-link findings are false positives, while external CLI execution, hosted-app data transfer, and Twitter/X automation remain real risks.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly into sh.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-shell examples with explicit download, checksum, signature verification, and then a separate execution step.

remediation.issue: Manual install uses shell substitution from a remote manifest.
remediation.suggestion: Use explicit platform-specific download URLs or a signed package manager release instead of command substitution.

remediation.issue: Downloaded binaries are moved into the user PATH.
remediation.suggestion: Verify the exact archive name, checksum, and signature before writing to ~/.local/bin or another PATH directory.

remediation.issue: Hosted app runs can send prompts, files, and outputs to third-party providers.
remediation.suggestion: Add clear consent guidance for sensitive data and provider review before running infsh app run commands.

remediation.issue: Twitter/X automation can publish or interact from authenticated accounts.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before social posting, direct messages, follows, likes, or retweets.

content.user_title: Run AI Apps from the CLI
content.value_statement: Teams need a consistent way to invoke many AI services without custom integrations. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to use the inference.sh CLI for discovery, execution, and task tracking.
actual_capabilities: Install and authenticate the inference.sh CLI using documented commands.
Discover apps by listing, searching, filtering categories, and viewing app details.
Run AI apps with input files or inline JSON through infsh app run.
Track long-running tasks and retrieve outputs with infsh task get.
Generate sample input files and save app results where supported.
Reference image, video, LLM, search, 3D, audio, and Twitter/X app categories.
limitations: Requires an inference.sh account, installed CLI, and authentication before app execution.
Sends prompts, files, and outputs to external cloud apps selected by the user.
Does not validate safety, policy, or pricing of every third-party app.
Twitter/X actions require credentials and can affect public accounts.

use_cases.title: Prototype multimodal AI workflows
use_cases.description: Find hosted models, generate sample inputs, run jobs, and inspect task results from one CLI workflow.

use_cases.title: Create media assets quickly
use_cases.description: Run image, video, audio, and 3D generation apps without managing local GPU infrastructure.

use_cases.title: Compare hosted model capabilities
use_cases.description: Search the app catalog, review provider options, and test LLM, search, and media apps with controlled inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Find an app
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-tools to find inference.sh apps for image generation. Show suitable options and explain when to use each one.

prompt_templates.title: Run a simple job
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-tools to run a hosted image app with this prompt: a clean product photo on a white background. Report the task result.

prompt_templates.title: Build a sample-driven workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-tools to get app details, generate a sample input file, explain the key fields, and run the app after I approve the input.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a long-running job
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-tools to submit a video generation job without waiting, capture the task ID, check status, and summarize the final output when ready.

output_examples.input: Find apps that can generate short product videos.
output_examples.output: A ranked list of relevant video apps, key provider names, expected input fields, and a recommended first test.

output_examples.input: Run an image generation prompt and track completion.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects an app, submits the job, reports the task ID, and summarizes the output URL when ready.

output_examples.input: Prepare a safe Twitter/X post workflow.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies the required X app, asks for confirmation, and explains the account action before running it.

best_practices: Confirm the app namespace, provider, and expected cost before long jobs.
Use sample input files for complex apps so parameters are visible before execution.
Review outputs and credentials before any public posting or account action.
anti_patterns: Running installer commands from an untrusted network without verification.
Sending private data to unknown apps or providers.
Allowing unattended social media actions from an authenticated account.

faq.question: Do I need an inference.sh account?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI must be installed and authenticated before most app commands can run.

faq.question: Can this skill run image and video models?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents image, video, audio, 3D, LLM, search, and utility app categories.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Where do results come from?
faq.answer: Results come from hosted inference.sh apps and may include cloud URLs for generated files.

faq.question: Can it post to Twitter/X?
faq.answer: Yes, when the account is configured. Confirm the exact action before posting, messaging, following, liking, or retweeting.

faq.question: Is sensitive data safe to send?
faq.answer: Only send data that is appropriate for the selected provider and app. Review app details before submitting private content.
